subject: Outbound proof handback & firewall signoff - hedged rotation model
messages:
From: secops@helixmed.com (Priya Venkatesh)
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: cloudops@helixmed.com
Date: 2028-07-08T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Private runtime  outbound evidence and signed firewall handback

Hi Mateo,

We're kicking off our final audit for the private runtime for Helix. To close the security review we need: 1) a flattened list of all outbound IPs that may egress from the private endpoint (static and expected ephemeral ranges), 2) an explicit note of which FQDNs your control plane will call and the expected ports, 3) a delegation artifact stating who at Redwood is permitted to accept firewall signoffs on our behalf, and 4) a signed PDF we can store in our audit tool.

As background, our platform only supports IP-based rules for a subset of appliances, so a CSV we can drop into our change ticket is preferred. Can you provide the artifact and an evidence bundle (pcap traces, cert fingerprints) by EOD Monday? Procurement is waiting on the signer list.

Thanks,
Priya Venkatesh
Principal SecOps, Helix Medical
secops@helixmed.com

Attachment: helix-ip-template.csv (their template)

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: secops@helixmed.com (Priya Venkatesh)
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-08T11:52:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private runtime  outbound evidence and signed firewall handback

Priya  thanks for the clear checklist. Quick clarifications so we deliver exactly what you need:

- We will provide per-region breakouts (us-east-1 / us-west-2) and a single canonical CSV for your change ticket.
- Ephemeral NATs: we operate an ephemeral NAT pool per-region; we will provide the pool CIDRs and documented rotation cadence rather than every ephemeral allocation. If you need per-allocation traces, we can include sampled egress traces in the evidence bundle.
- FQDNs/ports: controlplane.redwood-inference.net:443, telemetry.redwood-inference.net:443, and metrics.push.redwood-inference.net:443. We sign for the IPs behind those FQDNs and provide cert thumbprints.
- Signers: our recommended sign-off pair is David Kim (Head of Security) + Marissa Cole (Account Lead). We will produce a PDF delegation artifact and route via DocuSign.

I'll assemble the CSV and compressed evidence package and upload the DocuSign packet by Monday EOD. Looping Kimberly and David for formal signoff.

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Network Services Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

Attachments: none

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-09T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Re: Private runtime  outbound evidence and signed firewall handback

Mateo  forwarding for David and Marissa to confirm signer flow. David  if youre good with the delegation PDF and signature order (security first, account second), please sign and return. We should also include a short checksum manifest so Helix can verify the bundle after they download it.

Kimberly Park
Manager, Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-10T10:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Re: Private runtime  outbound evidence and signed firewall handback

Confirmed. I reviewed the CSV and evidence traces, converted the delegation record to a signed PDF, and attached the evidence bundle. Key excerpts: 

- Static control-plane collector IPs (us-east-1): 34.216.7.11, 34.216.7.12 (TCP 443)
- Ephemeral NAT pool (us-east-1): 52.48.200.0/24 (daily rotation window documented in manifest)
- Recommended allowlist guidance: allow FQDNs where possible; where only IP rules are supported, allow the static control-plane IPs and the ephemeral pool CIDRs with the understanding of rotation.
- Signed delegators: David Kim (Head of Security) and Marissa Cole (Account Lead). PDF has both signatures and a SHA256 manifest.

Attachments included in outbound bundle: firewall-signoff-VER-90123.pdf, evidence-bundle-VER-90123.zip, outbound-ip-handback-20280710.csv, docusign-signers-VER-90123.pdf

David Kim
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com

From: secops@helixmed.com (Priya Venkatesh)
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: cloudops@helixmed.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-10T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Re: Private runtime  outbound evidence and signed firewall handback

Thanks  we received the bundle and the signed PDF. Procurement will ingest the CSV into our change ticket and CloudOps will apply the rules tomorrow. A couple of follow-ups: 1) can you add a short note about expected TTLs for the ephemeral pool entries in the manifest, and 2) please attach the cert thumbprints for control-plane collectors to the evidence bundle. If you can drop an updated zip with those two items we can close the audit ticket.

—Priya
Principal SecOps, Helix Medical
secops@helixmed.com

Attachment: none
